answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch identity committed in a polynomial and prove membership through a Semaphore-style tree. For each epoch, an RLN proof permits only the allowed message rate; messages bind distinct rate-limit values to shares derived from the private key. Reusing a value yields conflicting Shamir shares, enabling key recovery and verification of the violation, so the bonded collateral can be slashed immediately. The prism, walnut, and lotus labels are merely domain-separation inputs, not security assumptions.
